_comment: Preferred audio devices, matched case-insensitively against Windows friendly names, first match wins; no match falls back to the Windows default. "default" = always the current Windows default device. Used by the engine and the audio test tools. Headset setup: JBL in stereo (A2DP 'Hovedtelefoner', not the 'Headset' hands-free endpoint, which drops to phone quality) + DJI Mic ('USB Audio Device').
